title: Founder of the Maratha Empire
summary: Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj was an Indian warrior king who founded the Maratha Empire in western India. He is widely regarded as one of the greatest warriors and administrators in Indian history, known for his innovative military tactics and progressive governance.

events.title: Birth of Shivaji
events.description: Shivaji was born on February 19, 1630 at Shivneri Fort near Junnar in present-day Maharashtra. He was named after the local deity Goddess Shivai.

events.title: Capture of Torna Fort
events.description: At the age of 16, Shivaji captured the Torna Fort from the Bijapur Sultanate, marking the beginning of Swarajya (self-rule). This was his first major military conquest.

events.title: Battle of Pratapgad
events.description: Shivaji defeated and killed Afzal Khan, a powerful general of the Bijapur Sultanate, in a legendary encounter at the base of Pratapgad Fort. This victory established Shivaji as a formidable military leader.

events.title: Battle of Pavan Khind
events.description: Baji Prabhu Deshpande made a legendary last stand at Ghod Khind to buy time for Shivaji's escape. The pass was later renamed Pavan Khind (Sacred Pass) in his honor.

events.title: Sack of Surat
events.description: Shivaji attacked the wealthy Mughal port city of Surat, seizing enormous wealth. This bold raid challenged Mughal authority and funded the Maratha expansion.

events.title: Visit to Agra & Escape
events.description: Shivaji visited Aurangzeb's court at Agra but was humiliated and placed under house arrest. He orchestrated a daring escape by hiding in fruit baskets, one of the most legendary episodes in Indian history.

events.title: Second Sack of Surat
events.description: Shivaji raided Surat for the second time, further demonstrating Maratha power and the inability of the Mughals to defend their wealthy trade center.

events.title: Coronation as Chhatrapati
events.description: Shivaji was formally crowned as Chhatrapati (sovereign king) at Raigad Fort on June 6, 1674. This grand ceremony established the Maratha Empire as an independent Hindu kingdom.

events.title: Southern Campaigns
events.description: Shivaji launched a massive southern campaign, capturing forts and territories across present-day Karnataka and Tamil Nadu, extending the Maratha Empire to its greatest territorial extent during his reign.

events.title: Death at Raigad
events.description: Shivaji passed away on April 3, 1680 at Raigad Fort at the age of 50. His legacy as a champion of Swarajya and a visionary leader continues to inspire millions.
